name: Scopevisio Cloud ERP
description: Read Scopevisio cloud ERP data: search contacts, outgoing and incoming invoices, projects and tasks, and open single records and invoice positions. Read-only, through the Scopevisio OpenScope REST API with a user sign-in.
instructions:
Scopevisio is a German cloud ERP. This adapter reads contacts, outgoing and incoming invoices, projects and tasks through the Scopevisio OpenScope REST API. It never writes.

**Getting credentials**
1. Use an active Scopevisio user with the rights for the data the agent should read: the profiles *Kontakte (Anzeigen)*, *Rechnungen (Anzeigen)*, *Rechnungseingangsbuch (Anzeigen)*, *Projekte (Anzeigen)* and *Aufgabe (Anzeigen)*. Scopevisio recommends a dedicated technical user (a functional address such as api@yourcompany.de) added to the company like any other user.
2. `SCOPEVISIO_CUSTOMER` is your 7-digit Scopevisio customer number, `SCOPEVISIO_USERNAME` and `SCOPEVISIO_PASSWORD` the user's login, `SCOPEVISIO_ORGANISATION` the exact name of the company (organisation) to read.
3. The connector cannot answer a one-time password: use a user without two-factor sign-in.

The connector signs in at `POST /rest/token` and renews the short-lived access token by itself. Issued tokens are listed, and can be revoked, in the customer lounge under **My REST API clients**.

**Where to start**: `scopevisio_get_account` checks the sign-in. Then search with the list tools and open one record with the get tools.

**Searching**: `search` is a list of criteria `{field, value, operator}` combined with AND; comma-separated values in one criterion are OR. Example: `[{"field":"lastname","value":"Muster","operator":"icontains"}]`. `fields` limits the columns, `order` sorts (`["lastname=asc"]`). Field names are Scopevisio's own: run one call without `fields` to learn them. Custom fields are named like `customText7`. A 403 means the user lacks the profile named in the tool description.

**Pagination and rate limits**: `page` starts at 0; `pageSize` defaults to 100, maximum 1000. Ask for the next page until fewer rows than `pageSize` come back. Scopevisio publishes no rate limit; on a 429, wait before retrying.

**Cloud reachability**: `appload.scopevisio.com` is a public HTTPS endpoint, reachable from AnythingMCP Cloud and from self-hosted instances alike.

SCOPEVISIO_CUSTOMER.label: Customer number
SCOPEVISIO_CUSTOMER.help: Your 7-digit Scopevisio customer number (Kundennummer), as used on the sign-in page.
SCOPEVISIO_CUSTOMER.patternMessage: The Scopevisio customer number has exactly 7 digits.

SCOPEVISIO_USERNAME.label: User e-mail
SCOPEVISIO_USERNAME.help: E-mail address the Scopevisio user signs in with. A dedicated technical user is recommended.
SCOPEVISIO_USERNAME.patternMessage: The e-mail address you sign in to Scopevisio with.

SCOPEVISIO_PASSWORD.label: Password
SCOPEVISIO_PASSWORD.help: Password of that Scopevisio user. The user must not have two-factor sign-in enabled.

SCOPEVISIO_ORGANISATION.label: Organisation (company) name
SCOPEVISIO_ORGANISATION.help: Exact name of the Scopevisio company (organisation) to read, as shown in Scopevisio.

verifyHints.400: Scopevisio refused the sign-in request. Check the customer number (7 digits) and the organisation name.
verifyHints.401: Scopevisio rejected the sign-in. Check customer number, e-mail and password, and that the user has no two-factor sign-in.
verifyHints.403: The Scopevisio user lacks the rights for this data. Give it the matching (Anzeigen) profile.

tools.name: scopevisio_get_account
tools.description: Show the signed-in Scopevisio user and customer account. No parameters and no profile needed; use it to check the sign-in.

tools.name: scopevisio_list_organisations
tools.description: List the Scopevisio organisations (companies) of this customer that the user can access, with id and name. Use it to find the exact organisation name for SCOPEVISIO_ORGANISATION.

tools.name: scopevisio_list_contacts
tools.description: Search Scopevisio contacts (customers, suppliers, people and companies). Filter with search criteria, e.g. lastname icontains Muster, or isAccount equal true for companies only. Needs the profile Kontakte (Anzeigen).

search.description: Search criteria, combined with AND. Each item is {field, value, operator}; several comma-separated values in one item are combined with OR. Example: [{"field": "lastname", "value": "Muster", "operator": "icontains"}].

field.description: Field name, e.g. lastname, documentNumber, status.

value.description: Value to compare with. Leave out for 'is null' and 'is not null'.

operator.description: equal, notequal, contains, icontains (case-insensitive), startswith, endswith, less, greater, lessorequal, greaterorequal, is null or is not null.

fields.description: Fields to return, e.g. ["id", "name"]. Leave out to get the default set and learn the field names.

pageSize.description: Rows per page, default 100, maximum 1000. Use 25 to 100 with fields to keep answers small.

tools.name: scopevisio_get_contact
tools.description: Get one Scopevisio contact by its numeric id, with all default fields or only the fields you name. Needs the profile Kontakte (Anzeigen).

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. id,name. Leave out for the default set.
